utterances.speaker: Me
utterances.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. Let's start with the quarterly roadmap review.

utterances.speaker: Them
utterances.text: Thanks for setting this up. I reviewed the draft roadmap last night.

utterances.speaker: Them
utterances.text: The design team needs about three more weeks to finish the onboarding flow.

utterances.speaker: Me
utterances.text: I think we should move the launch date to the second week of March.

utterances.speaker: Me
utterances.text: Can you send me the updated budget numbers by Friday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Them
utterances.text: One concern is that the analytics dashboard still has a few open bugs.

utterances.speaker: Them
utterances.text: We also need approval from legal before we publish the pricing page.

utterances.speaker: Me
utterances.text: Okay, let's circle back on the hiring plan next week.

utterances.speaker: Them
utterances.text: Great, talk to you all on Thursday.

monologue.text: Let me walk through the numbers from last quarter in a bit more detail. Revenue grew by about twelve percent, mostly from the enterprise accounts. Churn went down slightly, although the smaller customers are still leaving faster than we would like. Support tickets were flat, which is good given how many new users we added. For next quarter, the plan is to focus on onboarding and the mobile app. I will share the full deck after this call so everyone can review it.
